name: DRIFT_SAND_YELLOW_DIAMOND
notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W5-Q04 'Drift sand' warning sign (1995/2016, rev B). Size A 600 diamond generated (B 750, C 900 also tabled): a 600 side drawn as the bounding square 848.53, r 40, b 10 yellow edge + c 20 black border (separate spans on the sheet). Legend two lines f 120D (Series D, cap 120), gap d 60 between the lines, e 20 from the bottom of DRIFT down to the horizontal centreline (the sheet's chain f / e to the centreline, d across it / f): DRIFT cap top 424.27 - 20 - 120 = 284.27, SAND cap top 404.27 + 60 = 464.27. Black on retroreflective yellow.
